name: R — VAT quarterly return cycle, purchase VAT chargeable, levered facility
note:
R11 spec §17.4's worked cycle, pinned as the release's normative fixture, PLUS a levered facility and chargeable purchase VAT (§17.7) so the acquisition-tax uplift and a non-zero vat_carry_interest_pence are pinned in the same document rather than in isolation. See task-11-report.md for the full hand-derivation.

programme.packages.construction is EXPLICIT (start_offset 1, duration_months 4, straight_line) per Ruling R16 -- with programme: null the auto windows would spread construction over term-2 = 5 months for this 7-month term, not the 4 the worked cycle needs, and every reclaim figure would shift. HAND-DERIVED: construction_total_pence 100,000,000 (headline mode, base_build = construction_cost_per_sqm_pence 200,000 × total_construction_sqm 500, zero contingency, zero compliance) spreads EVENLY across months 1-4 at 25,000,000p/month -- uses[].construction_pence = [0, 25000000, 25000000, 25000000, 25000000, 0, 0], asserted before trusting any VAT figure.

VAT treatments: only 'acquisition' and 'construction' carry a non-zero rate (20%, 100% recoverable, zero_rated_sale -- new-build residential is the zero-rated first grant that makes input VAT recoverable). professional/statutory/selling/lender_ancillary are deliberately left at 0% so the fixture's month-by-month carry is hand-derivable as exactly two additive streams, not diluted by a third. finance.broker_fee_pence/lender_legal_fee_pence/valuation_fee_pence/monitoring_surveyor_fee_pence are all 0, so lender_ancillary's base is 0 regardless.

Construction VAT (§17.4's worked cycle, verbatim): 20% of 25,000,000p = 5,000,000p (£50,000) incurred in each of months 1-4, fully recoverable. Quarterly returns, first_period_end_month 2, repayment_lag_months 1: period 1 (months 0-2) incurs 0 + 5,000,000 + 5,000,000 = 10,000,000p, reclaimed month 3; period 2 (months 3-5) incurs 5,000,000 + 5,000,000 + 0 = 10,000,000p, reclaimed month 6; period 3 (month 6 alone) incurs nothing, so it never manifests as a reclaim event -- reported neither as a reclaim nor as receivable_at_maturity_pence (0), exactly as §17.4 requires for a period with nothing in it.

Acquisition VAT: purchase_price_pence 50,000,000, vendor_opted_to_tax true, togc_treatment does_not_apply -- is_purchase_vat_chargeable is true. Same 'acquisition' treatment row (rate 20%, recoverable 100%) resolves BOTH the ledger's acquisition VAT charge (money_round(50,000,000 × 20 / 100) = 10,000,000p, incurred and reclaimable in full) AND chargeable_consideration_pence (§17.7): 50,000,000 + 10,000,000 = 60,000,000p. Acquisition VAT is incurred entirely in month 0 (the acquisition month) and falls inside period 1's window, so it is reclaimed at month 3 ALONGSIDE construction's own period-1 reclaim -- the two streams merge in that one reclaim event but not before it.

Combining the two streams gives the fixture's actual month-end carry (cumulative incurred − cumulative reclaimed), hand-derived and NOT the pure single-category table: incurred = [10000000, 5000000, 5000000, 5000000, 5000000, 0, 0]; reclaimed = [0, 0, 0, 20000000, 0, 0, 10000000] (month 3 = period 1's 10,000,000 acquisition + 10,000,000 construction; month 6 = period 2's 10,000,000 construction alone); carry_pence by month = [10000000, 15000000, 20000000, 5000000, 10000000, 10000000, 0] (£000: 100, 150, 200, 50, 100, 100, 0). From month 3 onward this is IDENTICAL to §17.4's own table (50, 100, 100, 0 in £000) because the acquisition VAT is fully incurred AND fully reclaimed within the first three months; months 0-2 carry the table's own values (0, 50, 100) plus the acquisition VAT's constant 100,000p (10,000,000p) sitting uncollected until month 3. Peak carry is therefore 20,000,000p (£200,000) at month 2, not the isolated table's £100,000 -- the difference is exactly the acquisition VAT, and is reported here rather than silently reconciled away. total_input_vat_pence 30,000,000 (10,000,000 acquisition + 20,000,000 construction); total_recoverable_pence 30,000,000 (both categories 100% recoverable); total_irrecoverable_pence 0 (§17.5's invariant: fully recoverable VAT changes no cost line, so construction_cost_pence/professional_fees_pence/statutory_costs_pence/selling_costs_pence below are exactly what a registered:false twin of this document would show); total_reclaimed_pence 30,000,000; receivable_at_maturity_pence 0; purchase_vat_pence 10,000,000.

Acquisition tax (§17.7's uplift, non-residential SDLT, england_ni, bands unchanged since 2016-03-17): chargeable consideration 60,000,000p falls in the top (>25,000,000p) 5% band throughout its extension -- SDLT on the VAT-EXCLUSIVE 50,000,000p would be 1,450,000p (0 + 2%×10,000,000 + 5%×25,000,000 = 0 + 200,000 + 1,250,000), reused verbatim from fixture N/Q's own purchase price/legal/survey/broker/date. On the VAT-INCLUSIVE 60,000,000p it is 1,950,000p (0 + 200,000 + 5%×35,000,000 = 1,750,000) -- an uplift of exactly 500,000p (5% of the 10,000,000p acquisition VAT, since both considerations sit inside the same top band). acquisition_cost_pence = 50,000,000 (price) + 500,000 (legal) + 300,000 (survey) + 500,000 (broker, 1% of price) + 1,950,000 (tax) = 53,250,000.

Cost stack (hand-derived, headline cost_plan mode, zero contingency, zero compliance): construction_total_pence 100,000,000; professional_fees_pence 4,500,000 (architect 3,000,000 + structural_engineer 1,000,000 + other_professional 500,000, all fixed); statutory_costs_pence 1,000,000 (cil_s106 800,000 + building_control 200,000, both fixed); selling_costs_pence 3,250,000 (1.5% of gdv_pence 210,000,000 = 3,150,000, + 100,000 legal); cost_before_finance_pence 162,000,000 (53,250,000 + 100,000,000 + 4,500,000 + 1,000,000 + 3,250,000 + irrecoverable_vat 0). gdv_pence 210,000,000 (3 identical 2-bed units at 70,000,000p, no ancillary) = gdv_internal_pence, gdv_ancillary_pence 0, gross_sales_pence 210,000,000 (sell_all, nothing retained). developed_area_sqm / area_bridge.developed_area_sqm / area_bridge.manual_area_sqm 500 (manual basis, = conversion_costs.total_construction_sqm); area_bridge.unit_nia_sqm 240 (3 × 80); area_bridge.developed_gia_sqm 0 (no bridge-geometry field is non-zero); area_bridge.nia_to_gia_pct null. cost_plan.mode 'headline'; cost_plan.base_build_pence 100,000,000; cost_plan.contingency_total_pence 0; cost_plan.compliance_pence 0; cost_plan.construction_total_pence 100,000,000; cost_plan.professional_total_pence 4,500,000; cost_plan.statutory_total_pence 1,000,000; cost_plan.conversion_total_pence 105,500,000; cost_plan.lender_eligible_base_pence 0 (headline mode carries no packages, so the lender-eligible sum over an empty package list is 0 -- this is a headline-mode artefact of the field, not a statement that none of the build cost is lender-eligible); cost_plan.implied_rate_pence_per_sqm 200,000 (100,000,000 / 500).

A quarterly-return, first_period_end_month 2, 7-month-term document with a non-zero rate necessarily produces a final return period whose reclaim falls outside the modelled term (period 3, month 6 alone) -- validate_inputs reports the expected 'vat.repayment_lag_months' WARNING for this document (§17.4's own stated behaviour: 'reclaims falling after the final month are not received'), which does not affect report_safe.

INVARIANT-CROSS-CHECKED, not hand-derived (per Q's precedent -- these depend on the rolled-up monthly interest ledger, which is not hand-replayed here): finance_costs_pence, vat_carry_interest_pence, total_development_cost_pence, profit_pence and its two ratios, peak_debt_pence and peak_debt_month, net_ltc_pct/gross_ltc_pct/ltgdv_developer_pct, equity_contributed_pence, funding_gap_pence and the two cost_to_complete_* figures, day_one_advance_pence (55,250,000, a direct echo of finance.day_one_advance_pence). Taken from the engine only after the hand-derived cost stack and VAT figures above matched both engines to the penny on first run, with reconciliation.sources_equal_uses true, report_safe true and no unexpected flags.
